---
description: "Apply when creating or editing TypeScript or TSX files; run and address lint checks after code changes."
applyTo: ["**/*.ts", "**/*.tsx"]
---

# TypeScript Linting

- After generating or modifying TypeScript or TSX code, run `npm run lint`.
- Review the lint output and fix errors introduced by the changes before finishing.
- If linting cannot be run, state why and report that it remains unverified; do not claim it passed.
